<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is my fifth work session. I've sent two messages to Alison with the requested information and a follow-up, but I still haven't received a response. It has now been an hour and a half since I sent the full list of available slots.

At this point, I am still completely blocked. I have no new information and no actions I can take to move the task forward independently. My only option is to wait for Alison.

I have already sent a follow-up message, so sending another one so soon might be excessive. I will simply end my session and hope that Alison has had a chance to look at the calendars by my next session. There is nothing else I can do.
